Allows all 15 top-2 pairs but scores them with a fixed coverage-penalty lambda=2.0. In practice it collapses back to the three strict complement pairs, so routing freedom does not translate into better PPL.

Uses a strict complement base pair plus one extra free expert with free_expert_scale=0.5, raising active width to 1.5I. It is clearly better than the standard 6E 5K baseline, but still behind the best scratch 20K complement-pair run.

Continue from the best aux=0.0001 20K checkpoint with model-weight-only init, keep MoE lr=1e-4, and unfreeze the full transformer backbone at lr=1e-5 while keeping embeddings and lm_head frozen. Improves PPL@1024 by about 0.007 over the base 20K checkpoint.
Continue from the same best 20K checkpoint, but only unfreeze layer12-23 attn and norm parameters at lr=1e-5. Slightly improves PPL@1024 over the base 20K checkpoint, but the gain is extremely small.

Initialized from the dense MMfreeLM-370M checkpoint, upcycled into 6E complement-pair MoE, and jointly trained MoE plus layer12-23 local backbone for 20K steps. Training was stable and load balance stayed nearly uniform, but final PPL@1024 is clearly worse than the best scratch aux=0.0001 20K complement-pair run.

key_conclusions.partition_8e_vs_partition_4e_5k: worse on both 64-batch and 1024-sample evaluation despite healthy routing and strong expert separation
key_conclusions.partition_4e_20k_current_status: substantially improved over partition 4e 5k and close to the non-moe baseline by step 18000, but the run did not finish to 20000 step
key_conclusions.copy_noise_4e_full_top1_5k_takeaway: top-1 active-path-fair full-width routing improves dramatically over top-2 full-width at the same noise setting, but still remains above the non-moe baseline on stable 1024-sample evaluation
key_conclusions.complement_pair_6e_half_top2_5k_takeaway: under the unified reevaluation protocol, the complement-pair design preserves healthy ternary statistics, achieves much stronger specialization than full-copy noise baselines, and is effectively tied with the non-moe baseline: slightly worse at PPL@64 and slightly better at PPL@1024
key_conclusions.relaxed_complement_coverage_5k_takeaway: allowing all 15 top-2 pairs with a fixed coverage penalty does not improve the 6E half-width design at 5K; the model still uses only the three strict complement pairs and ends up slightly worse than the standard aux=0.0001 baseline at PPL@1024
key_conclusions.pair_plus_free_top3_5k_takeaway: adding one free expert on top of the strict complement base pair improves 5K perplexity materially over the standard 6E half-width baseline, but the gain comes from extra active compute at 1.5I and still does not approach the best scratch 20K complement-pair result
key_conclusions.mainline_reeval_20260525_scope: the non-moe baseline and main active-path-fair rows except virtual-group 8e half 20k were refreshed on 2026-05-25 with the current eval protocol; that virtual-group row remains historical because its output directory is unavailable
key_conclusions.continued_finetune_10k_takeaway: continuing from the best aux=0.0001 20K checkpoint with fresh optimizer/scheduler and selective low-lr backbone unfreezing yields only marginal additional gains; partial full fine-tune improves PPL@1024 by about 0.007, while local token-mixer+norm fine-tune is nearly tied with the base 20K checkpoint.

summary.copy_noise_4e_full_top1_20k_takeaway: training from scratch to 20k substantially improves over the 5k top-1 variant and now very slightly beats the non-moe baseline on both 64-batch and 1024-sample evaluation, but expert similarity remains very high.
summary.complement_pair_6e_half_top2_20k_takeawa: the complement-pair design continues to improve with longer training and now clearly beats the non-moe baseline on both 64-batch and 1024-sample evaluation while preserving moderate specialization and healthy ternary statistics.
summary.complement_pair_6e_half_top2_aux0001_20k: lowering router aux to 0.0001 and training from scratch to 20k yields the strongest complement-pair result so far, improving over the earlier aux=0.005 20k run without harming load balance.
summary.complement_pair_6e_half_top2_aux0001_lay: expanding MoE coverage to layers 6-23 increases parameter count but does not outperform the standard layer12-23 5k configuration, so depth expansion looks lower priority than staying on the 12-layer template.
summary.relaxed_vs_pairfree_5k_takeaway: among the two aggressive routing ablations, relaxed top-2 with coverage penalty fails to unlock new useful paths, while pair-plus-free top-3 is the only one that produces a clear 5K gain; that makes extra active compute look more promising than simply relaxing the pair constraint.
summary.continued_finetune_10k_priority: if continuation-style follow-up is pursued, partial full fine-tune ranks above local token-mixer+norm, but both gains are too small to justify treating continuation as a new mainline over the scratch 20K complement-pair baseline.
